evidence.quote:

observations.why: Speaker reports a verification/consequence claim (calibration holds under test) rather than invoking hierarchy or shared identity — a proportional evidence-to-conclusion framing.
Labeling items as ratified 'decisions' enacts a decision-of-record stance, asserting settled rank over the content rather than proposing or exchanging.
